note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the .do keeps REG12A's own columns P1203A-P1203D and sets item = the source column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no rename). The data dictionary's variable labels tie P1203A..D to the questionnaire's rows a..d ('a. si ella es infiel' = P1203A, 'b. si ella sale mucho?' = P1203B, 'c. si ella le desobedece?' = P1203C, 'd. si ella descuida la casa o los hijos?' = P1203D), 4/4 in the questionnaire's order. Row e ('...en otros casos se justifica?', P1203E, raw Sí/No/NR 72/3197/7) is not kept by the .do and is not in this table. RESP: the .do (Bookmark 2) sets 9 (NR) to missing and recodes (6=1)(1=2), so source 1 Sí / 6 No becomes live 1 = No, 2 = Sí; option_text is keyed to the LIVE codes (1 No, 2 Sí). Route 9: raw REG12A counts recoded equal live resp 1/2 in 8/8 item x resp cells; the unrecoded reading matches 0/8. Live 1/2 (= raw No/Sí): P1203A 3079/186, P1203B 3143/128, P1203C 3135/136, P1203D 3054/215. Dropped NR (9): 11/5/5/7 = 28 rows. Raw 3276 women (the .do asserts all 3276 survive its merges); live 13076 rows = 3276 x 4 - 28, 3273 ids (3 women NR on every row). validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (4 items, resp {1,2}). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): item_text = the questionnaire's 1203 stem '¿Usted justificaría que el esposo o pareja le pegue a la mujer...' joined to each row's text with the row letter and its own leading ellipsis dropped (same convention as the batch_601/602 siblings; the manual says 'LEA CADA ALTERNATIVA PAUSADAMENTE'). Row d's line-wrap ('descuida la casa o / los hijos?') joined. The questionnaire is shipped where the dictionary differs trivially: the dictionary stem omits 'le' ('pareja pegue a la mujer') and row a's label lacks the closing '?'. instructions left blank: Sección XII has no read-aloud framing before 1203 (the manual's 'El propósito de esta pregunta es indagar si la persona entrevistada justifica o no...' is guidance to the interviewer, and the 'ENCUESTADORA: LEA CADA ALTERNATIVA...' block is an interviewer direction), so nothing respondent-facing is shipped beyond the stem. option_text = the questionnaire's column headers verbatim (Sí, No; dictionary agrees); no row for NR 9. Single section_id, no section_prompt. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: INE publishes the ENSIMUP in Spanish only; all English produced by IRW ('le pegue' rendered 'hitting', 'descuida la casa' 'neglects the house'). Issues-page entry owed once live. STEP 3b: dictionary Description ('Whether a husband hitting his wife is justified if she is unfaithful, goes out a lot, disobeys, or neglects the home') matches 1203 rows a-d exactly; 4 live items = 4 rows; 2-level resp = Sí/No. RIGHTS: originator INE Paraguay; the questionnaire and manual cite no upstream instrument for 1203. public_note: The English wording for this table was produced by IRW, not by INE Paraguay, which publishes the ENSIMUP 2021 in Spanish only; and the response codes were reversed in processing so that 1 = No and 2 = Sí (yes), unlike the questionnaire's 1 = Sí, 6 = No.
